name: BepiColombo
first: First Europe + Japan joint planetary mission; second-ever spacecraft to orbit Mercury (after Messenger)
description: Joint ESA / JAXA mission to Mercury, launched 2018-10-20 — named after Italian mathematician Giuseppe (Bepi) Colombo, who designed Mariner 10's multi-flyby trajectory. The 8-year cruise uses 9 gravity assists (Earth 2020, Venus 2020, Venus 2021, then six Mercury flybys 2021–2024) plus continuous ion-electric thrust from the Mercury Transfer Module to bleed off the enormous solar-gravity gradient between Earth and Mercury orbits. Mercury orbit insertion 2026-12-05; science operations begin early 2027 after MTM jettison and separation of the two orbiters — ESA's MPO (planetary surface + composition) and JAXA's Mio (magnetosphere). Tests of general relativity via radio-science range tracking through Mercury's strong solar-gravity environment are also planned.

events.label: LAUNCH
events.note: Ariane 5 ECA lifts BepiColombo from Kourou on its 8-year ion-cruise to Mercury.

events.label: EARTH FLYBY
events.note: Single Earth gravity assist begins the inner-system gravity-assist chain.

events.label: VENUS FLYBY #2
events.note: Second Venus gravity assist begins the Mercury approach phase.

events.label: MERCURY FLYBY #1
events.note: First of six Mercury gravity assists.

events.label: MERCURY ORBIT INSERTION
events.note: MTM jettison + orbiter separation; science operations begin early 2027.
